cim: Registration Now Open for Ai4 2027, America's Largest Artificial Intelligence Conference, Expecting 20,000 Attendees in Las Vegas
cim_eredeti: Registration Now Open for Ai4 2027, America's Largest Artificial Intelligence Conference, Expecting 20,000 Attendees in Las Vegas
szoveg_eredeti:
Conference Will Feature 1,100+ Speakers, 600+ Exhibitors and Live Agentic AI Demonstrations

LAS VEGAS, NV / ACCESS Newswire / October 26, 2026 / Registration is now open for Ai4 2027, America's largest artificial intelligence conference, taking place August 2-5, 2027, at The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas. Building on the record-breaking success of Ai4 2026, the conference is expected to attract more than 20,000 business and technology professionals from 100 countries, feature 1,100+ speakers and showcase 600+ exhibitor booths, bringing together the world's leading AI researchers, technology innovators, business executives, investors and policymakers to explore the rapidly evolving future of artificial intelligence.

Attendees can take advantage of Super Early Registration, offering a 53% discount and savings of more than $1,800 off the final ticket price of $3,395. Prices increase February 4, 2027. To register, visit https://ai4.com/register/.

As artificial intelligence rapidly moves from experimentation to enterprise-wide implementation, Ai4 2027 will focus on helping organizations turn AI innovation into measurable business results. Through keynote presentations, real-world case studies, technical education, live demonstrations and networking opportunities, the conference will provide actionable insights and practical strategies for organizations looking to improve productivity, reduce costs, automate workflows and accelerate growth.

"Ai4 2027 is designed for organizations that are ready to move beyond talking about artificial intelligence and start realizing its full business potential," said Michael Weiss, Co-Founder of Ai4. "We're creating an environment where business leaders and technology professionals can learn directly from organizations successfully implementing AI, discover solutions they can put to work immediately and build partnerships that drive measurable results. From real-world enterprise case studies to live demonstrations of agentic AI, our goal is to ensure that every attendee leaves with practical strategies, valuable connections and a clear path to achieving a return on their investment."

In August, Ai4 2026 brought together some of the most influential voices in artificial intelligence, including Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, Andrew Ng, Sebastian Thrun, Pat Gelsinger and Tim O'Reilly. The 2027 conference will build on this momentum, connecting leading technology companies, innovative startups, enterprise executives, researchers and investors for four days of education, collaboration and business development.

A major highlight of Ai4 2027 will be the Agentic Live Demo Stage, featuring live demonstrations of autonomous AI agents performing complex tasks, automating workflows and supporting business operations. The stage will offer attendees a firsthand look at how agentic AI is being deployed in real-world enterprise environments.

"Ai4 is more than a conference - it's a place where AI innovation translates into real business results," said Marcus Jecklin, Co-Founder of Ai4. "Our attendees come looking for practical solutions, proven strategies and meaningful connections that can accelerate their AI initiatives. The results speak for themselves: 88% reported cost savings or revenue growth exceeding $100,000, 92% established lasting business partnerships and 87% put new strategies into action immediately after the event. These outcomes demonstrate the tangible value Ai4 delivers and why business leaders continue to make it a priority."

Beyond the conference sessions, the expanded exhibit hall will showcase hundreds of AI solution providers, emerging technologies and live product demonstrations. Attendees will also have opportunities to connect with C-suite executives, AI practitioners, researchers, entrepreneurs and investors from around the world.

Registration is now open for Ai4 2027, taking place August 2-5 at The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas. Super Early Registration offers savings of more than $1,800 off the final $3,395 ticket price, with rates increasing February 4, 2027. To register or learn more about the conference, visit https://ai4.com/register/.

Founded in 2018, Ai4 is America's largest artificial intelligence conference, bringing together business leaders, technology innovators, researchers, investors and policymakers to explore the latest advancements and real-world applications of AI. Through world-class education, live demonstrations, exhibits and networking, Ai4 connects the global AI community and helps organizations harness artificial intelligence to drive innovation and business growth. Ai4 is part of CloserStill Media, a global events company. For more information, visit https://ai4.com/.
